featured_reviews.review_text:
**1-star review:**

Very bad experience at Mark Suzuki Kurla West. Please document every conversation on paper or digitally, and check the scooter thoroughly before taking delivery. Take an expert with you, because after delivery they may not support you properly.

In my case, they fixed a damaged scooter guard and charged extra money for a rat cable product without clearly explaining it. The staff did not admit their mistake and were not transparent.

Beware.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dealing with Mr. Abraar from Mark Suzuki, Kurla, and I must say his sales service is truly exceptional. From the very first interaction, he displayed excellent professionalism, product knowledge, and customer care.

Mr. Abraar took the time to understand my requirements and guided me through every step of the car-buying process with complete transparency and patience. He explained all the features, variants, and offers in detail, helping me make the best decision without any pressure.

What impressed me most was his prompt communication, honesty, and genuine commitment to ensuring customer satisfaction. Even after the purchase, he followed up to make sure everything was smooth — something rare to find today.

featured_reviews.name: Manoj damgude
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a very disappointing experience with the service team. The Service Advisor misled me by suggesting I purchase an extended warranty for certain parts, but then issued a bill for four services within the year—even though I was already entitled to four free services from the company. When I questioned him, he falsely claimed that the company had already provided an extended warranty and that the free services applied only to that. This feels completely deceptive and like a scam. I would caution others to be careful and verify all information before agreeing to any services.

featured_reviews.name: James Singapuram
featured_reviews.review_text:
🚨 Scam Alert 🚨

My bike issue was not major; it was just a normal repair. I first went to Kurla Suzuki Service Centre, where they told me a part had to be replaced and gave an estimated cost of ₹4,000.

To cross-check, I went to Dharavi Suzuki Service Centre, where the mechanic clearly explained that it was only a minor issue and could be fixed without replacing any part. He repaired it by simple fixing and did not charge anything.

My experience with Kurla Suzuki Service Centre was very bad, and I strongly suggest customers verify the problem themselves or get a second opinion before agreeing to part replacement.

Also, always get your bike repaired in front of you so you can see whether parts really need to be changed or can be fixed. If they refuse and insist on replacement, don’t hand over your bike—you may fall into a trap.

⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐

I had an excellent experience at Raj TVS while purchasing my new TVS RTX 300. The entire team was extremely supportive, professional, and customer-friendly throughout the process.

A special thanks to Abhishek, Manish, Shantanu, and Samiksha for helping me choose the right product. Their guidance made the entire buying experience smooth and comfortable.

I would especially like to appreciate Shantanu, who did his absolute best to ensure that my loan was successfully approved. His dedication and effort truly made a difference.

Mr. Abhishek Shinde also deserves special mention for patiently answering all my questions — even the most basic and repetitive ones — without ever losing patience. His support and willingness to help made me feel very confident about my purchase.

I would also like to thank Ali and Sahil, who assisted with the bike setup and technical help. Their support and friendliness added to the overall great experience.

Overall, I received tremendous support from the entire team. I highly recommend RAJ TVS LLP, Kurla to anyone looking to buy a bike with excellent customer service and guidance.

featured_reviews.name: Gautami Kher
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a bike from TVS – Raj 2 Wheelers LLP, and unfortunately, the overall experience was extremely disappointing.

Despite informing the showroom in advance before leaving my place, the bike was not arranged on time, and I ended up receiving the delivery almost 2 hours late. What made the situation worse was the complete lack of coordination and product knowledge among the staff. There was no single point of contact, and most employees seemed unaware of the process or responsibilities.

Only Manager Manish and a bank representative, Shantanu, appeared to have any meaningful understanding of the product and the delivery status. The rest of the staff were mostly roaming around and were of no help, forcing me to repeatedly chase different people for basic updates.

The behavior of the reception staff was particularly unprofessional. They were more focused on their computers and showed little to no interest in assisting customers. When asked for help, their responses and expressions were dismissive and uncomfortable, making the customer feel unwelcome and unimportant.

Buying a new bike is a special moment for any customer, but this showroom managed to turn it into a frustrating and disrespectful experience. I strongly feel the staff needs proper training in customer service, ownership, and communication.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend this showroom to anyone looking for a smooth and respectful buying experience.
